title: Execute the milestone ledger status review and hardening plan (M0-M7)
description: Story B-9051 delivered docs/requirements/decisions/milestone-ledger-status-review-and-hardening-plan.md but only authored the plan document; all 8 milestones and 43 sub-objectives are still in planned status.
